Area.evidence_source: All participants struggled with health problems and mentioned unexplained pain and other physical symptoms they believed were related to the sexual violence. Emil said he did not have a strong connection with his body, was unhappy with it and had an unusually high pain threshold. Liam said he had suffered from severe abdominal pain, which he said was related to the violence. David has fibromyalgia and was convinced that it was related to the violence. Jonah said: I sometimes get twitches during the day [...] I cannot trace this directly to the trauma, but it all started at that time. After working on my mental problems, the twitches have diminished.
